blocks.content: To be greedy in our approach, we focus on the ending time of each class. The idea is simple: choose the class that ends the earliest.

items: Start with the class that ends the earliest. This is the first class you'll hold in this classroom.
Now, you must pick a class that starts after the first class and ends at the earliest. This is the second class you'll hold.

blocks.content: Repeat this pattern until you can't fit more classes.
